# PART 4 – The report and its record {.darkslide background-color="rgba(0,0,0,0)"}

::: {.partlabel}
Part 4 – 90 minutes
:::

::: notes
Last part. You now have code that reproduces a published result, and in this part it becomes a document. We look at a Quarto report from the inside, at how a number in a sentence can come from the code rather than being typed, and at what a clean run is and why you do one before believing anything. You put your reproduction into the report and render it. Then a look at what the code makes possible once it exists, and at how a project keeps its versions and ends up in an archive.
:::
